help.title: How can I download a story?
help.text: Open the story you want on Wattpad. Then copy the address from your browser's address bar – no matter whether you are on the info page or inside a chapter – and paste it into the input field on the home page. Alternatively, you can simply enter the story's ID.

help.title: Which format should I choose?
help.text:
We provide two formats: EPUB and HTML.
EPUB files are ideal for e-book readers like Tolino or Amazon Kindle. To load the story onto your reader, you can use software such as Calibre. The EPUB format also works with Apple Books on iPhone and iPad.
If you prefer reading on a PC or an Android smartphone, choose the HTML format. This file contains a complete reader including your story and can be opened in any browser. The reader also lets you adjust the font, font size and color mode.

help.title: Terms
help.text: This service is for private use only. Selling other people's downloaded e-books is not allowed! We do not endorse or condone such activity.
